thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated P50/P95 tail latency observed for eu-west-2 ingress. Automated classifier flagged possible GEO pin mismatch - 15% traffic to eu-west-2 is being routed to us-east-1. Paging sre-oncall-rey and netops-anne.

sre-oncall-rey: I'm on it. Joining bridge now. Can you share quick numbers and any recent routing changes?

netops-anne: saw a config push ~2h ago to geo-steer policies (deploy id: deploy/geo-steer/420). Looks like a tag mismatch: rule for eu-west-2 was updated to tag "region:eu-west-2" but traffic-engine maps "region:eu2". So fallthrough -> us-east-1.

eng-runtime-max: that deploy came from rollout/geo-steer-2026-03. I have the diff, it's a one-line rename. Noticed tests passed but didn't hit our legacy mapping layer.

sre-oncall-rey: ok step 1: rollback the policy to previous version. Anne can you queue rollback? Also increase pin-ttl on eu-west-2 to 300s to hold correct pins while rollback completes.

netops-anne: rolling back now (id: rollback/geo-steer-419). Command: ```rbacctl rollback policy geo-steer --to 418 && geoctl set pin-ttl eu-west-2 300```

netops-anne: rollback applied. Confirming routing tables... running `geoctl dump --region eu-west-2 | grep pin` -> shows pins back to eu-west-2 for main prefixes.

support-julia: support dashboard shows elevated lat for EU customers since 10:12Z. Incidents scaled to P1 for customers: AcmeApp, NovaSearch, and a few others. Ticket volume +10x. CSM Oliver copied.

csm-oliver: I'm on standby, prepping customer comms. Any ETA on full mitigation?

eng-runtime-max: ingestion side also saw backend timeouts due to cross-region hops. Short-term mitigation: enable local fallback model variant for eu-west-2 to reduce token processing time (command: `redwoodctl route --region eu-west-2 --force-variant small`). Doing that now.

sre-oncall-rey: running health checks, tail lat down from 800ms -> 220ms p95 within 2 mins. Error rate dropped from 7% -> 1.2%.

incident-bot: BRIDGE CREATED -> zoom.redwood/incident-2331112222  (owner: sre-oncall-rey)

netops-anne: also purged DNS cache on edge nodes: `for node in $(edges --region eu-west-2); do ssh $node "sudo systemd-resolve --flush-caches"; done`. Some clients still hitting cached entries; TTLs should expire in ~60-120s.

support-julia: Logged impacted customers and severity. Notifying customers on status page draft: "We are investigating increased latency for EU customers due to cross-region routing issue. Mitigation in progress."

csm-oliver: will escalate to enterprise contacts for AcmeApp and NovaSearch. Provide them ETA once stable for 15m.

eng-runtime-max: note: the root cause is the name change in rollout which missed backward compatibility in the mapping layer. We'll prepare a small patch to accept both tags and add unit tests.

sre-oncall-rey: current status: rollback completed, DNS purge done, local fallback variant enabled, p95 returning to normal. Keeping bridge open for postmortem.

incident-bot: METRICS -> p95 latency: 220ms (was 800ms), error-rate: 1.2% (was 7%), 15% traffic previously misrouted.

support-julia: opening Slack thread to affected customers with details and mitigation ETA.

netops-anne: making a follow-up change: add a defensive mapping so future renames won't slip through: `geoctl patch mapping --accept-aliases`. Will push after the bridge for small rollback risk.

eng-runtime-max: creating PR with mapping patch + tests (PR #6789). Tagging for fast-track review.

sre-oncall-rey: action items captured: 1) postmortem and timeline 2) PR for mapping fix 3) add canary that simulates legacy mapping 4) retro note to change deploy checklist to include mapping compatibility.

csm-oliver: customers informed, two had high-impact alerts but took no data loss, only increased latency/timeouts for some requests. They want SLA impact estimate.

sre-oncall-rey: estimate: impact window ~15 minutes of elevated errors (10:12Z-10:27Z). We'll produce formal SLA calc and include token counts.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation success. Bridge remains open for follow-up.

support-julia: closing customer-facing message: "Mitigation applied; traffic restored to EU region. We'll follow up with root cause and timeline."

sre-oncall-rey: handing off to oncall rotation for 2hr watch. I'll draft the incident stub and schedule postmortem.

netops-anne: will coordinate the mapping patch and schedule a safe redeploy in a maintenance window.

eng-runtime-max: will include compatibility tests and add deployment guard.

sre-oncall-rey: thanks team. Closing thread after postmortem entry.
